title: Test automation: seven weeks to the reward

days.label: Week 1
days.name: Count breakages
days.detail: List three months of incidents and count where things broke. Write nothing yet

days.label: Week 2
days.name: Write one test
days.detail: Write a single test for the part that breaks most. Coverage can wait

days.label: Week 3
days.name: Run it in CI
days.detail: Run that test on every push. Tests you only run by hand get forgotten

days.label: Week 4
days.name: Block on red
days.detail: A failing test blocks the merge. Only now does it protect anything

days.label: Week 5
days.name: One per incident
days.detail: Close each incident with a test that stops it coming back

days.label: Week 6
days.name: Share the habit
days.detail: Rotate who asks "where is the test?" in review each week

days.label: Week 7
days.name: Ship on Fridays
days.detail: CI tells you first when something breaks, so any day is a release day
